description: Position-balanced physical llama.cpp throughput comparison for the GGUF byte-budget experiment.

design.ordering: all six permutations of the three models, repeated twice; one fixed-seed shuffle (20261025)
design.comparison: Each candidate throughput was divided by source throughput within the same order-balanced round. Confidence intervals use paired ratios.

limitations: Single small Llama model and one llama.cpp build.
Each balanced run block has one measured repetition per model after warmup; intervals summarize order-balanced repeated blocks, not independent machines or runs across days.
No latency-to-first-token, model-loading-time, RAM, or VRAM claim is made from these throughput-only records.
No consistent throughput difference was resolved at these settings; this is not proof of equivalence.
